acceptance.1: In PersonasList (src/management/pages/Lists.tsx), orderPersonasByRoutedStrategies partitions rows with routedStrategies >= 1 before the others while keeping relative order within each group unchanged. Because ObjectListPage computes scopeCounts over the full list and filters each scope tab with Array.prototype.filter, the trading-first ordering holds on every scope tab (Current, Test, Retired, Research, All) and tab counts are unchanged.
acceptance.2: personaArchetypeText (src/lib/enumLabels.ts) maps the recorded codes momentum, generalist, and agora_servant to localized words in zh-TW (動能, 通用, 交易僕人) and en-US (Momentum, Generalist, Agora servant) with the raw code in the title tooltip. Unknown codes (e.g. mean_reversion, quant) are rendered as-is. Values that are sentences (containing whitespace, such as Risk Officer and Red Team mandates) render with block max-w-[104px] truncate whitespace-nowrap and the full sentence as title tooltip so sentence rows remain single-line (57 px at 1274x627 and 53 px at 1920x1000, identical to code rows).
acceptance.3: shortOwnerText (src/lib/enumLabels.ts) and OwnerCell (src/management/pages/Lists.tsx) strip the shared pantheon-dev- prefix on PersonasList and ArtifactsList so the cell shows the distinguishing part (admin-test, operator-a, operator-b, paper-provisioner, operator-bff) while preserving the full owner ID in title and data-full-owner.
acceptance.4: buildStrategyColumns (src/management/pages/Lists.tsx) renders strategy symbols inside an inline-flex flex-wrap container where each symbol item is a whitespace-nowrap span (data-testid=strategy-symbol-item). A symbol such as 2330.TWSE is never broken inside the code (clientRectCount = 1, height = 16 px), and multiple symbols (e.g. 2330.TWSE, 2317.TWSE) wrap between symbols.
